verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Next.js offering AI tooling that automatically resolves type errors from its type system. The built-in MCP endpoint only gives coding agents access to a running app, with no mention of type-error detection or fixing. Codemods are for version upgrades, and the community note about Claude Code is a third-party tool, not a Next.js capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can use AI tooling that automatically resolves type errors surfaced by the framework's type system
